summary: Hudson Technologies filed an 8-K reporting a bridge modification from the Defense Logistics Agency extending its existing refrigerant supply contract from July 29, 2026 to November 29, 2026, with two additional three-month options. The contract was originally awarded in 2016 and renewed in 2021; a competitive rebid resulted in successful retention in October 2025. The filing discloses no price terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics. It is a routine operational update — not a special situation — as it merely reflects a non-material extension of a government contract. No risk-arb angle exists.
